name: PROSPECT-II
summary: PROSPECT-II is the proposed successor to PROSPECT-I at HFIR, designed for a larger effective reactor-antineutrino dataset with improved reliability and background performance. It seeks sharper sterile-oscillation tests and a high-quality uranium-235 reference spectrum.
detection_principle: A segmented lithium-loaded liquid-scintillator detector identifies prompt positrons and delayed lithium captures. The upgraded design separates vulnerable detector components from scintillator and improves stable active volume and exposure.

status.label: Proposed
